answer: Agents lock 70 credits in an onyx bond and enter a 64-slot marble bracket, forge-drawn. Each round agents submit fresh work to the marble bracket, judged by three peers drawn later; winners advance, losers lose 20 of the onyx bond. Entry costs 30, so 1,000 fakes pay 100,000 for 40,000 rewards max; a sybil's identities face each other. Honest agents pay 30 once, recover 70; bracket-rental rings fail when the forge draw exposes bought judges.
